jobs.description:
FILOform, part of the CRH group, is an innovative solution-focused development and manufacturing company. They focus on smart solutions for connecting, sealing and protecting underground cable, fibre optics and utility networks.

For over 60 years FILOform has broadend their international and domestic network. With their HQ located in the UK and sites in The Netherlands and Germany, their global network is expanding every day. They currently export their products over 30 countries worldwide and provide worldwide support to a wide variety of industries, focusing on Telecom, Datacenters, Infrastructure and Energy. 

In order to broaden and complete their sealing portfolio, FILOform has joined forces with Wallmax, resulting in additional innovative solutions for their clients and prospects.

To secure the introduction and development of the FILOform & Wallmax portfolio, within sealing, protection and cable management solutions, we are currently recruiting a Technical Sales Engineer.

Jobomschrijving

You will be accountable for the introduction and development of the FILOform & Wallmax product portfolio within Belgium. You will initiate and implement the local sales strategy securing a solid market share for your region.

• You will step up, maintain, expand and develop long-term relationships with new & existing clients in order to achieve and exceed sales targets.
• You will proactively identify and pursue business opportunities across diverse industries such as Telecom, Datacenters, Infrastructure and Energy. By ensuring a close interaction with your key stakeholders you keep abreast on upcoming projects and needs.
• You are able to translate your customer’s challenges into qualitative solutions, ensuring fulfillment of their business needs whilst pursuing customer satisfaction, through dedicated business partnering.
• You will keep abreast of market trends and data, related to the FILOform & Wallmax Product Portfolio and industries, to identify and determine market opportunities, increase the business market share and secure further market penetration.
• You will present business reports, sales reports and forecasts on a monthly basis.
• You will liaise with internal and external stakeholders across all sites, as appropriate.
• You will be updating the CRM tools (Salesforce, …).
• You will report directly to the Sales Manager BENE with who you will have close interactions and regular meetings.

• Bachelor or Master background combined with a senior technical sales experience with a proven track record and client portfolio within the Energy, Infrastructure, Data or Telecom sector. 
• Demonstrated history of achieving sales targets, growing revenue, analyzing and following-up on KPI’s.
• Able to quickly master and understand all technical aspects of the business and flexible towards new product introductions.
• Able to manage long and complex commercial- and product approval processes.
• Used to work in an innovative environment with a strong international and customer-oriented mindset.
• Reliable and valuable business partner assuring strong stakeholder management.
• Strong analytical skillset with the ability to effectively analyze market trends and customer needs.
• Experience in tender management is a plus.
• You are based in Belgium and are flexible to travel across the country to visit clients.
• Flexible to travel to The Netherlands and/or UK when required (limited).
• This role is a stand alone role that is mainly managed from a Home Office setting.
• You are fluent in English, Dutch and French.

jobs.occupation: Head of Inside Sales & Customer Development
jobs.description:
Our client is an international, fast-growing organization operating in a highly dynamic and data-driven B2B environment. As part of a leading European group, the Belgian organization combines entrepreneurial agility with the structure and support of an international matrix organization. To support its continued growth and further strengthen its customer-facing operations, our client is looking for a Head of Inside Sales & Customer Development.

Jobomschrijving

As Head of Inside Sales & Customer Development, you will play a pivotal leadership role within the Belgian organization. You will be responsible for leading a team of 30-35 Inside Sales & Customer Advisors across multiple locations, ensuring operational excellence, commercial performance and an outstanding customer experience. 

Working closely with both the Belgian leadership team and international stakeholders, you will translate strategic objectives into clear deliverables driving accountability and ownership. 

• Build a high-performing organisation by developing talent, empowering Team Leads and fostering a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement. 
• Establish clear performance frameworks, monitor business-critical KPIs and proactively steer the organisation towards ambitious commercial and operational objectives. 
• Continuously evaluate and optimise workflows, sales processes and customer interactions to improve efficiency, quality and overall business performance. 
• Leverage data, reporting and digital tools to identify trends, generate actionable insights and support informed decision-making. 
• Act as the driving force behind operational change, successfully embedding new initiatives, technologies and best practices across the organisation. 
• Build trusted relationships with key internal stakeholders, ensuring strong cross functional collaboration and alignment within an international matrix environment. 
• Champion a customer-centric mindset by balancing commercial ambition with service excellence and long-term customer value. 
• Play an active role within the Belgian Management Team, contributing to the company's strategic direction and supporting its continued growth. 

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, providing a strong foundation for a commercial leadership role. 
• Proven track record managing larger inside sales, contact centre or customer service teams within a B2B environment preferably within an international and/or matrix driven organisation. 
• Extensive people management experience and know how to coach teams towards performance and accountability. 
• Strong analytical mindset combined with experience managing performance through KPIs, reporting and data analysis. 
• Demonstrated experience improving operational processes and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. 
• Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively across different organizational levels. 
• Comfortable working in a fast-changing environment where adaptability and resilience are essential. 
• Affinity with digital transformation, AI tools and process automation is considered a plus. 
• Fluency in Dutch, French and English are required.

Are you organized, customer-oriented, and ready for a new challenge in international logistics?

As an Air Import Agent, you play a crucial role in coordinating export processes and providing excellent customer service. Read on and discover what your future could look like in our dynamic team!

Jobomschrijving

As an Air Import Agent, you are responsible for smoothly and timely coordinating air freight and providing excellent customer service. You ensure that everything, from freight transportation to administrative processing, runs seamlessly.

As an Air Import Agent, you engage in the following activities:

• Ensure smooth and timely freight process flow.
• Ensure accurate and timely data entry into our operating system.
• Track and trace Air Import files as required. This can be either internally via exp.o or externally via airline websites or by telephone to
airline offices.
• Use Tree View on daily basis.
• Ensure timely delivery of freight to customers for Import shipments.
• Ensure documents are timely sent to customer or broker for customs purposes.
• Ensure accurate and timely client and vendors billing.
• Interact with our customers in arranging their international shipments, meeting customer service standards.
• Contribute to maintain strong relationships with vendors (airlines, trucking companies, and others).
• Meet compliance at all times to regulations. 
• Understand department process flow, constantly looking for areas of improved efficiency.
• Ensure all customers standard operating procedures are followed and updated in the DLSOP.
• Overseas communications, timely responses to emails and requests (internal and external)
• Meets company standards of 52 hours training per year per employee.
• Promote compliance in diligently following all company policies and regulations and performing the task at hand with outstanding
integrity and pride.

The Air Import Agent we're looking for:

• 2- 3 years of experience withing air freight (import specifically)
• Proactive attitude and well-developed organizational skills.
• Good knowledge of Excel and Word; experience in air freight/logistics is a plus.
• Very good knowledge of English AND Dutch
• IATA certification is a plus.
• A positive mindset, problem-solving ability, and a good sense of humor.

Are you looking to take your first steps in corporate accounting? An established company in the Groot-Bijgaarden region is seeking a Junior Corporate Accountant to join their team. In this role, you will assist in preparing periodical and annual stand-alone and consolidated financial statements while managing and controlling the accounts of holding and financing entities within the group.

Your Responsibilities as Junior Corporate Accountant:

Corporate Accounting for Holding & Financing Entities:

• Prepare general ledger transactions for holding and financing entities.
• Compile monthly trial balances, general ledger reconciliations, interim accounts, and statutory annual accounts.
• Collaborate with auditors to ensure accurate preparation and approval of accounts.
• Handle VAT returns on a monthly and yearly basis for designated corporate entities.
• Resolve accounting discrepancies, process vendor payments, and address irregularities within your scope of responsibility.
Treasury Management:

• Maintain and reconcile intra-group and external borrowing schedules, ensuring timely notification and payment of interest and principal loan repayments.
• Monitor daily cash-pool movements.
• Support administrative processes related to banking operations.
Process & Systems Improvement:

• Ensure financial records comply with internal policies and procedures.
• Identify opportunities to improve accounting control processes.
• Participate in control systems applicable to holding and financing entities.
• Enhance existing documentation and workflows for greater efficiency.

Your profile as Junior Corporate Accountant:

• You hold a bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or economics.
• You are either a recent graduate or have gained initial professional experience in accounting, financial controlling, consolidation, or reporting.
• You have a foundational understanding of Belgian or Luxembourg accounting principles; basic knowledge of IFRS is an advantage.
• You are fluent in English, and proficiency in French and/or Dutch is considered a valuable asset.
• You are proficient in MS Office applications, with strong skills in Excel. Familiarity with SAP S/4 Hana Public Cloud is a significant plus.
